plugins.name: keyword-planner
plugins.description: Google Ads Keyword Planner integration — generate keyword ideas, pull historical search volume, and forecast performance directly in Claude.

plugins.name: google-ads
plugins.description: Google Ads MCP server plus skills for search-term mining, negative-keyword work, campaign builds, and naming conventions. Reads and writes a live account via the Google Ads API.

plugins.name: meta-ads
plugins.description: Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram) MCP server plus skills for account auditing and creative performance analysis. Fetches real creative — including video transcripts and keyframes — not just metrics.

plugins.name: creative
plugins.description: Skills-only research and creative toolkit: market and competitor research, peer-reviewed mechanism research, a 52-template creative format library, ad concept strategy, and direct-response copywriting. Channel-agnostic.

plugins.name: reporting
plugins.description: Cross-channel budget pacing and performance review across Google Ads and Meta. Day-aware pacing tolerance, 3-month day-matched baselines, bucket thresholds, and conversion-volume reallocation logic. Skills-only; orchestrates the google-ads and meta-ads plugins.
